meaning: Own finite private factory-to-owned-value execution through independently source-derived module surfaces, strict compilation, original provider-call observations and retained artifact/tool currentness.
inputs: Registered checked graph, reconciled plan, complete boundary inventory and independently registered owned-value controls with equal source/plan/boundary identities; exact execution definition bytes. Owned-value readiness must not require or fabricate factory-to-Rule rejection witnesses. Empty ready coverage rejects before workspace creation.

source_surface.derivation: Derive factory, Rule, named Entity/Value Object, plain Enum component/definition/runtime and payload-sum paths and named value/type exports from decoded source contracts, checked selected field bindings and configured roles. Reconstruct each import occurrence, including repeated fields and type-only references, without parsing generated text for expected answers. Compare expected closure with static inventory and bind captured artifact bytes.
source_surface.roles: Entity/Value Object modules export Fields and Snapshot types plus create<Name>Factory, <Name>ValueComponent and <Name>FieldBindings values. Rules export rule<Name>. Payload Enum modules export Input/Case types and ValueComponent; plain Enum components export Case and ValueComponent and import their definition. Plain definitions export the source name as both type and value and import defineEnum and EnumValue. Shared Enum runtime has exact pinned source and exports defineEnum/composeEnum values and EnumValue type.
source_surface.closure: Only ready owned-value root closures execute. Reuse typed-source derivation for factory, Rule, Entity, Value Object, plain Enum, named payload-sum and type-only dependencies; preserve each repeated import occurrence. Type-only targets may join compilation/auditing without native loading. Retain all non-selected runtime edges as uncovered; presence in the closure is not invocation proof.

native_surface: Independently parse original TypeScript and emitted CommonJS with selected TypeScript API. Check every static named import occurrence, type-only erasure, complete type/value exports and bounded ambient syntax restrictions. Reject dynamic/nested/aliased require, namespace escape, export reassignment or extra binding, runtime reexports, external imports and unknown CommonJS export forms. Explicitly permit required compiler-generated export initialization and statically named original factory/owned-component initialization; this is bounded syntax assurance, not universal purity.
source_custody: Use captured immutable artifacts and independently reconstructed surfaces, not mutable authoring reads. Fresh owned workspace retains exact source/native/config/script/input/output and complete Node/TypeScript/platform fingerprints, checked before/after child execution and on receipt assertion. Changed, missing, extra, symbolic or nonregular selected files reject; not atomic isolation against privileged concurrent writers.
execution: Use unchanged registered owned-value lifecycle controls and original isOwned/key instrumentation. Only requested base factory create/reconstruct/Entity transition calls count; dependency construction, previous-state setup, foreign-instance creation and output inspection stay outside capture. Native input contains recipes, never expected answers. Both AST audits precede restricted native behavior. Exact observations include argument identity paths, ownership results, key results, input stability and getter counts.
tools: Node 26.8.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, same retained private execution limits and permission-restricted CommonJS lane. No ambient type packages.
receipt: Registered immutable owned-values-specific result binds this execution definition, source surface digest, unchanged behavioral controls digest, graph/plan and exact audits/native observations/artifacts/tool fingerprints. Factory-to-Rule and owned-value registrations cannot substitute for one another. Cloned or stale receipts reject; errors retain only their owned workspace for inspection.
claim_ceiling: Finite private instrumented factory-to-owned-value evidence with independent source/native surface audits and retained custody. Not internal named-sum payload construction, Enum runtime realization, factory-to-Rule coverage, universal purity, uninstrumented equivalence, public cross-generator completion, a default change, release or authority.
